title: Outlook mobile: refreshed Copilot Chat sheet with the new and temporary chat button moved behind the ... menu
summary: Hold: the briefing labels the refresh on by default, but the roadmap and Microsoft documentation checked do not state its activation or rollout default. The roadmap details, licensing background and both admin paths are supported; Microsoft's pages also disagree about whether Integrated Apps blocking affects Teams.

claims.claim: Microsoft's August 2024 release notes record Copilot Chat becoming available in Outlook for iOS and Android.
claims.quote:
## August, 2024
### Outlook
Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Outlook Mobile [Android, iOS]
The Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat experience is now available in Outlook for iOS and Android.

claims.quote: The Copilot app is an integrated app that provides Copilot Chat via web, in the Microsoft Copilot app (web, desktop, mobile) and in Outlook (web, desktop, mobile).

claims.claim: No documented automation is established for the Copilot app's Integrated Apps self-install availability setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Integrated Apps" "Specific users" "Graph" API; "Integrated apps" "availability" "PowerShell" Copilot Outlook. Read Integrated Apps, Manage Copilot Chat and Package Management overview; no API tied to the Copilot app self-install audience was documented.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[1].note; Scope: Roles; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The cited Integrated Apps controls are available only to Global Admins.
claims.quote: The following controls on the integrated apps portal in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center are only available to Global Admins.

claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app through Integrated Apps blocks it tenant-wide across the Microsoft Copilot app, Outlook and the web, including licensed users.
claims.quote: If you block the Copilot app using the Integrated app control, you block the Copilot app tenant-wide across the Microsoft Copilot app, Outlook, and the web, including for users assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: Integrated Apps blocking does not affect Teams, which retains its Teams admin center setting.
claims.quote: The app is only be blocked in the Microsoft Copilot application and Outlook. Teams continues to honor the current setting for Teams Apps made in the Teams admin center
claims.fix: Replace "Teams keeps its Teams admin center setting" in the row note with "The Integrated Apps guide says Teams keeps its Teams admin center setting, but Manage Copilot Chat says this block also affects Teams." Make the same qualification in the corresponding prose bullet, citing https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-copilot-chat#block-users-from-using-copilot-chat, which states: "This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users."

claims.claim: The CoPilot app settings in Integrated Apps apply to both Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: On the Integrated Apps page, the CoPilot app settings apply to both Microsoft Copilot and the Copilot Chat apps. Any changes made to this app from the integrated apps portal apply to both.

claims.claim: Specific users/group in the organization can install limits self-installation and use to the selected users.
claims.quote: Specific users/group in the organization can install means that only the users selected by you are able to install the app on their own from the store and use it in the client. Unselected users are not able to do so.

claims.claim: The app availability setting does not affect admin-deployed apps.
claims.quote: The availability setting of an app doesn't impact any admin deployed apps. The availability setting only allows you to control which end users can install and use these apps on their own.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Integrated Apps controls govern access to the Copilot app that supplies Copilot Chat in Outlook.
claims.quote: The Copilot app provides Copilot Chat in the Microsoft Copilot app and Outlook across web, desktop, and mobile, and on the web at m365.cloud.microsoft/chat. You manage the app through the Integrated Apps portal in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.

claims.claim: The Package Management API reference describes managing agents rather than establishing automation for the Copilot app.
claims.quote: A package represents an agent or a tool, such as a plugin, MCP server, or skill, in the organization catalog. The Package Management API enables IT administrators to view and manage agents and tools across your organization.
